Multi-ingredient: Chile: Sistalgina†; Venez.: Sistalcin Compositum. Pregnancy and Fertility Tests Pruebas de embarazo y de fertilidad. Profile There are a number of kits available for simple pregnancy and fertility testing. A common method of detecting pregnancy is to use specific antibodies to measure the increase in chorionic go- nadotrophin in the urine. The period of ovulation can be detected by measuring luteinising hormone excretion in similar ways. These tests can give false results. Those carrying out the tests should be aware of this and of problems such as contaminated specimens, drug therapy, or other factors that could affect the re- sult.
